question_text: In a △ABC, prove that 4(r₁r₂ + r₂r₃ + r₃r₁) = (a + b + c)².

recall_prompt: Say how you would prove this — name each standard result you use and the order you use them in.

steps.label: Write each product
steps.margin_note: Half the marks. Each ex-radius is Δ over its own bracket, so each product is Δ² over a product of two brackets — and all three share Δ².

recall.must_convey: That each product is Δ² over two brackets, and combining over the common denominator (s−a)(s−b)(s−c) leaves the three brackets summed on top.
accept: each product is delta squared over two brackets so combining gives the third bracket on top each time
put them over the common denominator of all three brackets
the numerator becomes the sum of the three brackets
common denominator teeskunte numerator lo brackets sum vasthundi

steps.why: When two of the three brackets are in a denominator, combining over all three puts the MISSING one on top — which is why the numerator ends up as their sum.
common_mistakes: Adding the numerators without a common denominator.
Getting the wrong bracket on top of each term.

steps.label: Use Heron and conclude
steps.margin_note: The other half. The brackets add to s, and Δ² = s(s−a)(s−b)(s−c) means the bracket product IS Δ²/s — so everything cancels down to 4s².

recall.must_convey: That Σ(s−a) = s, that (s−a)(s−b)(s−c) = Δ²/s from Heron, and that everything cancels to 4s² = (a+b+c)².
accept: the brackets add to s and heron gives the bracket product as delta squared over s so it all cancels to four s squared which is a plus b plus c squared
use herons formula to replace the denominator
four s squared is two s all squared which is the perimeter squared
heron formula vaadi cancel cheste four s square vasthundi
everything cancels leaving four s squared

steps.why: Heron's formula read backwards gives the product of the three brackets. That substitution is what makes the Δ² cancel entirely and leaves a pure side expression.
common_mistakes: Not recognising the bracket product in Heron's formula.
Leaving the answer as 4s² without writing (a+b+c)².
